title: Search Autocomplete
vague_prompt: Design type-ahead autocomplete for a search box.
hidden_guidance: 8 billion searches per day, and about 10 keystroke requests per search
Suggestions must return in under 100 ms at p99
Only the top 10 suggestions for each prefix matter
Suggestion order follows query frequency from the last 24 hours, refreshed every hour
The index covers about 100 million distinct queries
About 2 percent of submitted queries hit the banned list and must be filtered from the result
known_patterns: Trie or prefix hash index over the query set
Precomputed top 10 list stored for each prefix
Frequency aggregation from query logs with a batch and a streaming path
Short TTL cache at the edge for popular prefixes
Filter layer for banned and offensive terms
Shard by prefix to spread the load
common_misses: Cache TTL and invalidation after a trending event
Hot prefix shard for very common letters
Storage cost of top 10 lists for every prefix
Freshness lag between a spike in searches and the new ranking
